taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage: gain-boosted telescopic NMOS-input first stage + PMOS
* common-source second stage, Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
* Slow first-stage CMFB sets the inter-stage common-mode level (into vbp);
* fast output CMFB steers the second-stage NMOS loads.
* All bias generated on-chip from iref (50 uA into an NMOS diode).

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* nb0 = iref node (diode-connected NMOS, 50 uA)
XMBN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
* vbp: PMOS current-source bias (branch sink 20 uA; CMFB1 dumps into vbp)
XMBP0 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMBN1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* reference for first-stage CMFB: replica of the second-stage PMOS driver
* (1/8 scale, 32 uA) so n1 tracks the level that sets the right stage-2 current
XMPBR refn1 refn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=4
XMBNR refn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13 nf=2

* ---------------- stage 1: telescopic pair, boosted cascodes ----------------
XMNT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=136 nf=8
XMN1A n1da vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=48 nf=4
XMN1B n1db vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=48 nf=4
* NMOS cascodes (gates set by common-source boosters)
XMN2A n1a vgcna n1da vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XMN2B n1b vgcnb n1db vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* PMOS current-source loads (60 uA each)
XMP1A nspa vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=10
XMP1B nspb vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=10
* PMOS cascodes use grounded-gate fixed bias (strong cascode, no headroom cost)
XMP2A n1a vss nspa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=66 nf=6
XMP2B n1b vss nspb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=66 nf=6

* ---------------- cascode boosters (self-biased common-source) ----------------
* NMOS cascode boosters: sense n1dx, output vgcnx (10 uA)
XBBN1A vgcna vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=17 nf=2
XBBN2A vgcna n1da vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=4
XBBN1B vgcnb vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=17 nf=2
XBBN2B vgcnb n1db vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=4

* ---------------- stage 2: PMOS common source + NMOS loads ----------------
XMP3A voutp n1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=16
XMP3B voutn n1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=16
XMN4A voutp vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=51 nf=6
XMN4B voutn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=51 nf=6

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CCA n1a nza 2.0p
RZA nza voutp 400
CCB n1b nzb 2.0p
RZB nzb voutn 400

* ---------------- first-stage CMFB (slow, sets n1 common mode) ----------------
* sense n1 common mode through resistors with feedforward caps
RSN1A n1a n1s 10meg
RSN1B n1b n1s 10meg
CSN1A n1a n1s 200f
CSN1B n1b n1s 200f
RSN1C n1s refn1 18meg
* LVT PMOS pair (sense n1s ~0.72 V), NMOS mirror, output current into vbp
XMT1 nt1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=66 nf=6
XME1S nmir1 n1s nt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=4
XME1R vbp refn1 nt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=4
XMM1A nmir1 nmir1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMM1B vbp nmir1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------- output CMFB (fast) ----------------
RSENP voutp vcms 1meg
RSENN voutn vcms 1meg
CSENP voutp vcms 100f
CSENN voutn vcms 100f
RCM vcms vocm 590k
* error amplifier: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, diode-loaded output at vbn
XMETA nete iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=72 nf=8
XMEA nmir vcms nete vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=6

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage Miller-compensated: folded cascode (PMOS input) + common-source
* with continuous-time CMFB

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* === Bias Generation ===
* NMOS reference diode: sinks 50uA from external source
Xm_ref nbias1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
* PMOS bias diode: creates pbias1
Xm24 vdd pbias1 node_b1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
Xm22 node_b1 nbias1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
* NMOS cascode bias stack
Xm28 vdd pbias1 nbias_casc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
Xm29 nbias_casc nbias_casc node_bc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5 nf=4
Xm30 node_bc2 nbias1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2

* === First Stage: Folded Cascode (PMOS input) ===
* PMOS tail current source (250uA)
Xm9 tail1 pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=8
* PMOS input differential pair (125uA each)
Xm1 n1 vinp tail1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=4
Xm2 n2 vinn tail1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=4
* NMOS cascode transistors
Xm3 n1 nbias_casc n1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5 nf=4
Xm4 n2 nbias_casc n2b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5 nf=4
* NMOS current sinks (250uA each)
Xm5 n1b nbias1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=8
Xm6 n2b nbias1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=8
* PMOS current sources into folded nodes (125uA each)
Xm11 n1 pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=8
Xm12 n2 pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=8

* === Miller Compensation ===
Cmc1 n1 voutn 3.5p
Cmc2 n2 voutp 3.5p

* === Second Stage: Common-Source with Active Load ===
* NMOS common-source (driven by first stage output)
Xm35 voutn n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
Xm36 voutp n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
* PMOS active loads (driven by CMFB)
Xm33 voutn cmfb_out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=46 l=1 nf=32
Xm34 voutp cmfb_out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=46 l=1 nf=32

* === Continuous-Time CMFB ===
* Resistive sensing of output common-mode
Rcmfb1 voutp cmfb_sense 100k
Rcmfb2 voutn cmfb_sense 100k
* CMFB differential amplifier
Xm41 cmfb_tail pbias1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=1 nf=4
Xm42 cmfb_n1 cmfb_sense cmfb_tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
Xm43 cmfb_out vocm cmfb_tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
Xm50 cmfb_n1 nbias1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
R_cmfb_load cmfb_out vss 16k

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA
* Two-stage: NMOS-input folded cascode + NMOS CS with PMOS loads
* All bias from iref via resistor dividers from VDD
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* === Bias Generation ===
* NMOS diode reference: iref sinks 50uA, sets nbias = iref voltage
XNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS diode: VDD -> pbias -> iref (series path, 50uA)
XPB pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
R_PB pbias iref 1m
* NMOS tail bias: resistor from VDD + NMOS sink (50uA)
R_NTBD vdd ntail_bias 24k
XNBT ntail_bias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* NMOS cascode bias: resistor from VDD + NMOS sink (50uA)
R_NCAS vdd ncas 10k
XNBC ncas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* === First Stage: NMOS-input Folded Cascode ===
* NMOS tail current source (~200uA, gate=ntail_bias ~0.6V)
XMNTAIL ntail ntail_bias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
* NMOS input pair (~100uA each)
XM1 ninp vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XM2 ninn vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* NMOS cascode devices (gate=ncas ~1.3V)
XMNC1 n1p ncas ninp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7 nf=2
XMNC2 n1n ncas ninn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7 nf=2
* PMOS current source loads (~100uA each, gate=pbias)
XMPS1 n1p pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMPS2 n1n pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* === Second Stage: NMOS CS with PMOS Active Loads ===
* Cross-connect for correct polarity: n1n->voutp, n1p->voutn
XMNS1 voutp n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNS2 voutn n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* PMOS active loads (standard VT, controlled by CMFB)
XMPL1 voutp ncmfb_out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMPL2 voutn ncmfb_out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* === CMFB Amplifier ===
* NMOS diff pair
XCMFB1 ncmfb_out vocm ncmfb_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XCMFB2 ncmfb_n ncmfb_s ncmfb_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* NMOS tail (self-biased from iref, small current ~10uA)
XCMFBT ncmfb_src iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* PMOS diode loads
XCMPL1 ncmfb_out ncmfb_out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XCMPL2 ncmfb_n ncmfb_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* CMFB sensing resistors
RCMFB_P voutp ncmfb_s 1meg
RCMFB_N voutn ncmfb_s 1meg

* === Miller Compensation (cross-coupled to match signal path) ===
CC1 n1p voutn 1p
CC2 n1n voutp 1p
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA for Cs=Cf=CL=1pF.
* Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode + first-stage CMFB.
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source drivers + cascoded NMOS loads + output CMFB.
* Miller compensation with zero-nulling resistor. Bias entirely from iref.
* nf=1, m= used for current scaling.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ===========================================================================
* Bias. LVT diode reference sets iref ~0.58V so Vdsat stays small.
* ===========================================================================
XNREF   iref   iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20

XNPB    pbgen  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XPREF   pbgen  pbgen  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20

XNCBC   ncasb  pbgen  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8
XNCD2   ncasb  ncasb  nca1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XNCD1   nca1   nca1   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20

* Replica: PMOS diode (driver size) into NMOS current source (driver current)
* -> vrep = driver gate bias.  First-stage CMFB forces mid CM = vrep.
XREPP   vrep   vrep   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=12
XREPN   vrep   iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=10

* ===========================================================================
* First stage: NMOS-input folded cascode.
* ===========================================================================
XMINP   fdp    vinp   tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=5
XMINN   fdn    vinn   tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=5
XMTAIL  tail   iref   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=5

XMPFP   fdp    vfsg   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 m=2
XMPFN   fdn    vfsg   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 m=2

XMCNP   midp   ncasb  fdp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4
XMCNN   midn   ncasb  fdn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4

XMPUP   midp   pbgen  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=20 m=2
XMPUN   midn   pbgen  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=20 m=2

* First-stage CMFB: (midp+midn)/2 -> vrep.  NMOS-input OTA, PMOS mirror load.
RSM1    midp   mcm    1Meg
RSM2    midn   mcm    1Meg

XCMTS   cmtail iref   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4
XCMP1   cmfl   mcm    cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=2
XCMP2   vfsg   vrep   cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=2
XCM3    cmfl   cmfl   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=2
XCM4    vfsg   cmfl   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=2

* ===========================================================================
* Second stage: PMOS drivers + cascoded NMOS loads.  Output CMFB.
* ===========================================================================
XMPDP   voutp  midp   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=12
XMPDN   voutn  midn   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=12
XMNCP   voutp  ncasb  onp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4
XMNCN   voutn  ncasb  onn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4
XMNSKP  onp    vnsg   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=10
XMNSKN  onn    vnsg   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=10

RZP     midp   mzp    1k
RZN     midn   mzn    1k
CCP     mzp    voutp  2.5p
CCN     mzn    voutn  2.5p

* Output CMFB: (voutp+voutn)/2 -> vocm.
RSO1    voutp  ocm    1Meg
RSO2    voutn  ocm    1Meg

XOCMTS  ocmtail iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=4
XOCMP1  ocml   ocm    ocmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=2
XOCMP2  vnsg   vocm   ocmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 m=2
XOCM3   ocml   ocml   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=2
XOCM4   vnsg   ocml   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 m=2

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (Cs=Cf=1pF, CL=1pF).
* Topology:
*   - NMOS-LVT folded-cascode first stage (high gain, low noise)
*   - Stage-1 CMFB1 defines DC of the high-Z cascode outputs
*   - Common-source second stages with LVT-PMOS current sources
*   - Output CMFB2 drives the stage-2 PMOS gates
*   - Miller Cc+Rz; minimum-current PMOS keep stage-1 alive under large swings
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref is sunk by an external 50uA source from vdd.
* PMOS must be pfet_01v8_lvt (|Vt|=0.32V; regular pfet |Vt|=1.065V is off at 1.8V).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ bias
XREF   iref  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=4

* vcasn = Vgs(cascode diode) + Vgs(sink diode) so XNSP stays in saturation.
RCN    vdd   vcasn 100k
XCB1   vcasn vcasn nb1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=80
XCB2   nb1   nb1   vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=2

* vcasp: two LVT-PMOS diodes (w=80) with 200uA -> ~0.45V
XDP1   pd1   pd1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=80
XDP2   vcasp vcasp pd1   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=80
XDSNK  vcasp iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=16

* vmin: fixed PMOS gate bias for the minimum-current sources (~1.2V)
XMIN   vmin  vmin  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=20
XMINS  vmin  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=4

* vb1 clamp: two LVT-PMOS diodes limit vb1 to ~1.15V so XPCP never cuts off
XCLP1  pcl   pcl   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=10
XCLP2  vb1   vb1   pcl   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=10

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage 1
* folded cascode. Side P: gate vinp -> out1p. Side N: gate vinn -> out1n.
XPCP   nfp   vb1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=80
XPCN   nfn   vb1   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=80
* minimum-current PMOS (gate=vmin) keep the fold nodes alive under large swings
XMINP  nfp   vmin  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=20
XMINN  nfn   vmin  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=20
XCPP   out1p vcasp nfp   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=80
XCPN   out1n vcasp nfn   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=80

XINP   nfp   vinp  ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=100
XINN   nfn   vinn  ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=100

XCNP   out1p vcasn ndp   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=80
XCNN   out1n vcasn ndn   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=80
XNSP   ndp   iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=4
XNSN   ndn   iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=4

XTAIL  ntail iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=32

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ CMFB1
RS1P   out1p vs1   2meg
RS1N   out1n vs1   2meg
X1A    c1a   vs1   t1    vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=20
X1B    vb1   vocm  t1    vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=20
X1C    c1a   c1a   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=20
X1D    vb1   c1a   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=20
X1E    t1    iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=8
CC1    vb1   vdd   1p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage 2
* wide devices -> low Vdsat -> wide output swing for the 3 dB span
X2N    voutp out1p vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=120
X3N    voutn out1n vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=120
X2P    voutp vb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=150
X3P    voutn vb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=150

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ CMFB2
RS2P   voutp vs2   2meg
RS2N   voutn vs2   2meg
X2A    c2a   vs2   t2    vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=20
X2B    vb2   vocm  t2    vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=20
X2C    c2a   c2a   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=20
X2D    vb2   c2a   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=20
X2E    t2    iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=8
CC2    vb2   vdd   0.3p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Miller
RZP    out1p mzp   1k
CCP    mzp   voutp 6p
RZN    out1n mzn   1k
CCN    mzn   voutn 6p

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage Miller-compensated amplifier with continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: LVT NMOS diff pair with PMOS current-source loads and
*          resistive DC loads that define the first-stage output level.
* Stage 2: wide NMOS common-source (high gm2) with PMOS current-source load.
* PM is set by gm2/C_L vs UGB = gm1/Cc; Cc is kept small so UGB stays high
* while gm2/C_L remains above UGB.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias from iref (50uA) ----------------
XNREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
XNBP   nbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
XPBIO  nbp  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=4

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
XMN1   db1  vinn stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=8
XMN2   db2  vinp stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=8
XTAIL  stail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=32 nf=4
* PMOS current sources: 200uA (4x of 50uA diode) — 100uA into pair, 100uA into RDL
XMP1   db1  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=256 nf=8
XMP2   db2  nbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=256 nf=8
* resistive DC loads define db1/db2 near 1.0 V
RDL1   db1  vss  10k
RDL2   db2  vss  10k

* ---------------- second stage (high gm2) ----------------
XMN5P  voutp db2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
XMP5P  voutp vbp_cm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=8
XMN5N  voutn db1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
XMP5N  voutn vbp_cm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=8

* ---------------- Miller compensation (small Cc for high UGB) ----------------
RZP    db2  mzp  100
CCP    mzp  voutp 200f
RZN    db1  mzn  100
CCN    mzn  voutn 200f

* ---------------- continuous-time CMFB ----------------
RCMP   voutp cms 200k
RCMN   voutn cms 200k
XCM1   cmn   cms  cmstail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XCM2   cmout vocm cmstail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XCMT   cmstail nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=64 nf=4
XCM3   cmn   cmn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XCM4   cmout cmn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XSF    vdd  cmout vbp_cm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XSFT   vbp_cm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (v1)
* Two-stage Miller OTA with continuous-time output CM feedback.
* All internal bias is derived from iref (50 uA reference from VDD).

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- bias: iref-referenced current mirrors ----
XM0   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMXC  xbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPBC xbc xbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- stage 1: NMOS diff pair, resistor loads, output CM = 0.9 V ----
XM1   n1 vinp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM2   n2 vinn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMS1  s1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=6
R1   n1 vdd 6k
R2   n2 vdd 6k

* ---- stage 2: NMOS diff pair, PMOS cascode pull-ups ----
XM9   voutp n1 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XM10  voutn n2 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMS2  s2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=13

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (v1)
* iref is the only external analog bias; all internal bias voltages and
* continuous-time output CM feedback are generated inside the DUT.
* SKY130 01v8 MOS wrappers + ideal R/C compensation/feedback elements.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- bias reference: diode-connected NMOS sets Vgs from iref (50 uA) ----
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
* ---- tail current mirror (300 uA tail) ----
XMTP ttail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
* ---- input stage: NMOS differential pair ----
XM1 d1 vinp ttail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XM2 d2 vinn ttail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
* ---- cascode devices (NMOS), gate from vdd divider (~1.10 V) ----
XM3 sa vbn_cas d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XM4 sb vbn_cas d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RVBN1 vdd vbn_cas 100k
RVBN2 vbn_cas vss 300k
* ---- PMOS current-source loads, gate from vdd divider (~1.25 V) ----
XM5 sa vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XM6 sb vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
RVBP1 vdd vbp 200k
RVBP2 vbp vss 200k
* ---- output stage: rail-to-rail inverter pair driven by sa/sb ----
XM7 voutp sa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XM8 voutp sa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XM9 voutn sb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XM10 voutn sb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
* ---- output CMFB sense ----
RCS1 voutp vcm_sense 100k
RCS2 voutn vcm_sense 100k
* ---- CMFB error amplifier (resistor tail and loads) ----
XMEA1 ea_out vcm_sense etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMEA2 ea_ref vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
RET etail vss 100k
REO ea_out vdd 100k
REFQ ea_ref vdd 100k
* ---- CMFB sink devices at the outputs ----
XMCSP voutp ea_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMCSN voutn ea_ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----
RZP voutp mzp 200
CZP mzp sa 200f
RZN voutn mzn 200
CZN mzn sb 200f
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

circuit:
* v_final: two-stage fully differential Miller OTA with CMFB (converging target)
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* -------- bias reference (iref = 50 uA) --------
Xrefn iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* NMOS current mirrors (gate = Vbiasn = iref)
Xit1 it1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=1     * stage-1 tail
Xit2 it2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=1 * stage-2 tail (slew)
Xmet et iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=10 nf=1      * CMFB error-amp tail
* -------- stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS current mirror load --------
XM1 n1 vinp it1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60 nf=1
XM2 n2 vinn it1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=60 nf=1
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=1
XM4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=100 nf=1
* -------- stage 2: NMOS diff pair + PMOS current mirror load --------
XM5 voutp n1 it2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XM6 voutn n2 it2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XM7 voutp voutp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
XM8 voutn voutp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
* -------- Miller compensation (cross-coupled) --------
CCc1 voutp n1 1p
CCc2 voutn n2 1p
* -------- CMFB: sense output CM --------
Rcm1 voutp cm 100k
Rcm2 voutn cm 100k
Xe1 errc cm et vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
Xe2 e2 vocm et vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
Rerrc errc vdd 50k
Re2 e2 vdd 50k
XMcms cm e2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
Ce2 e2 vss 2p
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA, SKY130.
* Two-stage Miller: gain-boosted NMOS-input folded cascode, direct-coupled
* LVT NMOS output drivers with long PMOS loads. Continuous-time CMFB on the
* output-stage load gates; a second slow CMFB trims stage-1 aux sinks so the
* first-stage output common mode follows a replica of the driver Vgs.
* All bias generation from the 50uA iref sink. Widths are total widths.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias branches. iref node diode XN0 carries the external 50uA.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
* PMOS master reference pb0 (50uA branch).
XP0 pb0 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10
XNB0 pb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
* Fold-source gate reference pb_s1 (~31uA branch, density of XPF1/2).
XPFS pb_s1 pb_s1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=26
XNFS pb_s1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=9
* Fold-sink gate reference nb1 (~17uA branch, density of XNL1/2).
XPFK nb1 iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=3
XNDK nb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4.8
* Tail gate reference nb_t (~30uA branch, density of XMT/2).
XPTT nb_t iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=5.5
XNTT nb_t nb_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=9.6
* N-boost PMOS tail gate pbnbt (~6uA branch, density of XTNB/2).
XPBT pbnbt pbnbt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.2
XNBT pbnbt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.7
* P-boost NMOS tail gate nbpbt (~60uA branch, density of XTPB).
XPPT nbpbt iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=11
XNPT nbpbt nbpbt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=15
* Stage-2 driver Vgs replica fref (~45uA branch at 1/4 current density).
XPRF fref iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8.5
XDRF fref fref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=10
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode, gain-boosted cascodes.
* Input pair ~150uA/side, fold sources ~345uA/side.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 f1 vinp ps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=100
XM2 f2 vinn ps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=100
XMTC ps nb_t ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=96
XMT ts nb_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=96
* NMOS cascode branches (sinks).
XNL1 n1s nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48
XNC1 f1 nbo2 n1s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48
XNL2 n2s nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48
XNC2 f2 nbo1 n2s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48
* PMOS fold sources and cascades.
XPF1 c1s pb_s1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=300
XPC1 f1 pbo2 c1s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=200
XPF2 c2s pb_s1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=300
XPC2 f2 pbo1 c2s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=200
* N-boost amp: PMOS pair (f1,f2), NMOS mirror load. nbo2 -> gate of
* the f1-branch cascode, nbo1 -> f2 branch (cross-coupled).
XTNB nbt_n pbnbt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12
XBA nbo1 f1 nbt_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
XBB nbo2 f2 nbt_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
XBLA nbo1 nbo1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.2
XBLB nbo2 nbo1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.2
* P-boost amp: NMOS pair (f1,f2), PMOS mirror load. pbo2 -> gate of
* the f1-branch cascade, pbo1 -> f2 branch (cross-coupled).
XTPB pbtp_n nbpbt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=15
XPA pbo1 f1 pbtp_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
XPB pbo2 f2 pbtp_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
XPLA pbo1 pbo1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.5
XPLB pbo2 pbo1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.5
* Startup keepers: pre-bias the P-side cascade gates from the quiet
* fref bias node so the fold-source branches conduct at power-up.
* Steady-state disturbance is ~1uA total, absorbed by the boost loop.
RSP1 fref pbo1 200k
RSP2 fref pbo2 200k
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage-1 output CMFB. Resistive sense of CM(f1,f2) vs the driver
* replica reference fref; amp drives aux NMOS sinks at f1/f2.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RF1 f1 fcm 20k
RF2 f2 fcm 20k
RT1 st1 vss 3.3k
XSF1 ca1s fcm st1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=15
XSF2 fb1a fref st1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=15
XSLA ca1s ca1s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8
XSLB fb1a ca1s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8
CFS fb1a vss 300f
XAUX1 f1 fb1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30
XAUX2 f2 fb1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: LVT NMOS drivers gated directly by f1/f2, PMOS loads
* gated by the output CMFB node.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XD1 voutp f1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=90
XD2 voutn f2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=90
XL1 voutp cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=280
XL2 voutn cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=280
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors at f1/f2.
RZ1 f1 mz1 700
CC1 mz1 voutp 2.2p
RZ2 f2 mz2 700
CC2 mz2 voutn 2.2p
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output CMFB: resistive divider sense, NMOS pair vs vocm, PMOS
* mirror output drives the load gates. cms up -> cmfb up -> loads
* source less -> negative feedback.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RS1 voutp cms 40k
RS2 voutn cms 40k
RT2 ct2 vss 550
XCA ca1 cms ct2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80
XCB cmfb vocm ct2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80
XCLA ca1 ca1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
XCLB cmfb ca1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25
CCM cmfb vss 500f
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA, SKY130.
* PMOS-lvt-input gain-boosted folded cascode. Both output branches are
* gain-boosted cascodes: the NMOS fold branch (MS1+MS2) and the PMOS
* current-source branch (MPU+MPC). Continuous-time CMFB senses the output
* common mode through 50M resistors (DC) in parallel with 0.4p caps (AC)
* and drives the PMOS source gates; Miller caps stabilize the CM loop.
* This model install: pfet_01v8 |Vth|~1.0V (avoided in the signal path);
* pfet_01v8_lvt |Vth|~0.41V; nfet_01v8 Vth~0.56V; nfet_01v8_lvt ~0.37V.
* All internal bias is generated from iref (50uA pulled into the DUT).
*
* Signal path: PMOS-lvt pair (drains xp/xn) folds through NMOS fold
* devices into the boosted cascode-branch source nodes ylp/yln; MS2
* carries the signal to the outputs. PMOS-lvt pullups (gates = cmfb)
* feed the outputs through boosted PMOS cascodes.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- input pair and tail ----------------
XMTAIL t vbtail vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=360 nf=60
XMIPP xp vinn t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=280 nf=40
XMINN xn vinp t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=280 nf=40

* ---------------- fold into the cascode branches ----------------
XMFP ylp vfold xp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=8
XMFN yln vfold xn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=8
* current sinks below xp/xn (iref-bus gates, low Vov)
XMSP xp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=16
XMSN xn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=16

* ---------------- NMOS cascode branch (boosted) ----------------
XMS1P ylp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XMS1N yln iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XMS2P voutp gs2p ylp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16
XMS2N voutn gs2n yln vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=16

* ---------------- PMOS source branch (boosted) ----------------
XMPUP pp cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=400 nf=40
XMPUN pn cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=400 nf=40
XMPCP voutp pcbp pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=440 nf=56
XMPCN voutn pcbn pn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=440 nf=56

* ---------------- boost amplifiers ----------------
* NMOS branch: PMOS-input two-stage amp senses ylp against vrefy.
XABP vdd vss pbg iref ylp vrefy gs2p auxbp
XABN vdd vss pbg iref yln vrefy gs2n auxbp
* PMOS branch: NMOS-input amp senses pp against vrefp; inverting from pp
* so the local loop is negative (pp up -> pcb down -> PMOS cascode more
* on -> pp back down).
XABPP vdd vss pbg iref vrefp pp pcbp auxb
XABPN vdd vss pbg iref vrefp pn pcbn auxb

* ---------------- continuous-time CMFB ----------------
* DC sensing through 50M; AC speed-up through 0.4p.
RSP voutp vcm 50M
RSN voutn vcm 50M
CFSP voutp vcm 0.4p
CFSN voutn vcm 0.4p
CSC vcm vocm 0.1p
XCMA vdd vss pbg iref vcm vocm cmfb cmfbamp
* Miller compensation of the CM loop (through the inverting PU stage).
CMCP voutp cmxp 2p
RMCP cmxp cmfb 200
CMCN voutn cmxn 2p
RMCN cmxn cmfb 200

* ---------------- bias generation from iref ----------------
* iref node: NMOS diode (wide, low Vov) sets the NMOS gate-bias bus.
XMNBI iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=23 nf=4
* pbg: PMOS-lvt diode dropped from vdd, NMOS current copier forces 50uA.
XMPBI pbg pbg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=28 nf=4
XNBP pbg iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=23 nf=4
* vbtail: PMOS-lvt diode sunk by a half-size copy of iref.
XMNTB vbtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
XMTD vdd vbtail vbtail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=15 nf=2
CTB vbtail vss 0.2p
* vfold replica: half-size pbg mirror copy of the fold diode density in
* series with a resistor; xp = I*R holds across corners.
XMPRF vdd pbg vfold vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=14 nf=2
XMFRD vfold vfold vrfx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=11 nf=2
RFR vrfx vss 8.2k
CF vfold vss 0.2p
* vrefy = vocm/3 (boost reference for ylp/yln, tracks the output CM).
RHY vocm vrefy 22k
RLY vrefy vss 11k
CY vrefy vss 0.2p
* vrefp ~ 1.52 (boost reference for pp/pn).
RHP vdd vrefp 5.6k
RLP vrefp vss 30k
CP vrefp vss 0.2p
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

* ----------------------------------------------------------------
* Two-stage boost amplifier with PMOS input pair (senses low nodes).
* Output stage is an NMOS common source with a resistive pullup so the
* output can swing high enough to drive the NMOS cascode gates.
* Sign: sense up -> out up (non-inverting); it is instantiated with the
* inputs swapped so the NMOS boost loop is overall inverting.
.subckt auxbp vdd vss pbg nbg vref sense out
XMTB stp pbg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=28 nf=4
XM1 d1 vref stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=68 nf=8
XM2 d2 sense stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=68 nf=8
XMN1 d1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
XMN2 d2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
XM3 out d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
RPU out vdd 33k
CO out vss 0.1p
.ends auxbp

* ----------------------------------------------------------------
* Single-stage boost amplifier, NMOS input pair (senses nodes > 0.7V),
* PMOS mirror load. Inverting from the sense input.
.subckt auxb vdd vss pbg nbg vref sense out
XMTA st nbg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
XM1 d1 vref st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=17 nf=4
XM2 out sense st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=17 nf=4
XMP1 vdd d1 d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
XMP2 vdd d1 out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
CO out vss 0.1p
.ends auxb

* ----------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time CMFB error amplifier.
* NMOS pair compares vcm against vocm; PMOS mirror load with the vcm
* device on the diode side; output (cmfb) drives the PMOS pullup gates.
* Sign: vcm up -> cmfb up -> less pullup current -> output CM down.
.subckt cmfbamp vdd vss pbg nbg vcm vocm cmfb
XMTA st nbg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=92 nf=16
XMC1 d1 vcm st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=34 nf=8
XMC2 cmfb vocm st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=34 nf=8
XMP1 vdd d1 d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
XMP2 vdd d1 cmfb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
CC cmfb vss 0.15p
.ends cmfbamp

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 1, 40 ns Settling, 300 uVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA, SKY130 continuous models.
* Stage 1: NMOS-input telescopic cascode, fixed cascode-gate biases.
* Stage 2: class-A common-source. Miller compensation with series Rz.
* CMFB1 senses stage-1 output CM (oa/ob) and trims pb3.
* CMFB2 senses final output CM and drives PMOS trim sources M7.
* All bias generated internally from iref (50uA nominal).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* Master NMOS diode at iref pin.
XBN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.6 nf=2
* 50u branch producing pb0 (PMOS diode gate reference).
XBN1 pb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.6 nf=2
XBP0 pb0 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* Tail bias, 200u degenerated diode -> nb_t1.
XBP_T1 nbt1 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
RT1 nbt1 nb_t1 600
XBN_T1 nb_t1 nb_t1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=26.8 nf=4
* NMOS cascode gate bias, 50u stack -> nb_c2 ~ 1.05V.
XBP_C2 nbc2s pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
RC2 nbc2s nbcd 8.2k
XBN_C2D nbcd nbcd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.6 nf=2
CBC2 nbc2s vss 2p
* PMOS cascode gate ~0.35V (divider), PMOS load gate 80u diode -> pb3.
R4A vdd nb_p4 100k
R4B nb_p4 vss 24k
CBP4 nb_p4 vss 2p
XBN3S pb3 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.5 nf=2
XBP3R pb3 pb3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=74 nf=12
* Stage-2 PMOS load gate, 300u diode -> pl0.
XBN2 pl0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=5
XPL0 pl0 pl0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=240 nf=35
* CMFB tails, 200u degenerated diode -> nb_ct (100u per CMFB pair).
XBP_CTT nbctt pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
RCT nbctt nb_ct 1.2k
XBN_CTD nb_ct nb_ct vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
* CMFB1 stage-1 output CM reference ~0.66V.
R3A vdd vroa 52k
R3B vroa vss 30k

* ---------------- stage 1: telescopic cascode ----------------
XMN0 s1 nb_t1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=26.8 nf=4
XMN1a d1a vinp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12.5 nf=2
XMN1b d1b vinn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12.5 nf=2
XMN2a oa nbc2s d1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.4 nf=2
XMN2b ob nbc2s d1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.4 nf=2
XMP3a d3a pb3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=74 nf=12
XMP3b d3b pb3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=74 nf=12
XMP4a oa nb_p4 d3a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=74 nf=12
XMP4b ob nb_p4 d3b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=74 nf=12

* ---------------- CMFB1: oa/ob CM -> auxiliary tail current ----------------
* High-value DC sense; slow error amp steers a tail trim device (bipolar authority).
RSA oa oacm 1meg
RSB ob oacm 1meg
CCM oacm vss 20p
XCM1A dcm1a oacm cm1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=2
XCM1B dcm1b vroa cm1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=2
XMCL1 dcm1a dcm1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMCL2 dcm1b dcm1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XCM1T cm1t nb_ct vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.4 nf=2
CCM2 dcm1b vss 0.5p
XMNT1A s1 dcm1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=13.4 nf=2

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
RZA nza voutp 270
CCA nza oa 1.2p
RZB nzb voutn 270
CCB nzb ob 1.2p

* ---------------- stage 2: class-A CS (L=2, low vdsat for edge ro) ----------------
XMN5a voutp oa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=440 nf=64
XMN5b voutn ob vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=440 nf=64
XMP6a voutp pl0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=240 nf=35
XMP6b voutn pl0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=240 nf=35

* ---------------- CMFB2: output CM -> M7 ----------------
* 100k DC sense (low-Z node, pole ~10MHz), 0.4p AC sense, feedforward 3p
* caps to dcb give instant pulse response; L=2 mirror load for DC gain.
RSPDC voutp vcms 100k
RSNDC voutn vcms 100k
CSPAC voutp vcms 0.4p
CSNAC voutn vcms 0.4p
CSEN vcms vss 0.1p
CFFP voutp dcb 3p
CFFN voutn dcb 3p
XMCT cmft nb_ct vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=4
XMCA dca vcms cmft vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=16
XMCB dcb vocm cmft vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=16
XMCL3 dca dca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12
XMCL4 dcb dca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12
CCOMP dcb vss 2p
XMP7a voutp dcb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12
XMP7b voutn dcb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12

.ends sampling_feedback_ota
